purpose: Teach: いとも/まぎれ/分り/むやみ/待ち受け/飽きる/とっとと/有り得

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、いとも簡単にテスト解いたな
lines.en: Riku, you solved that test way too easily.
lines.style: Bright, surprised admiration. Quick rhythm on the observation. A teasing lilt underneath — she's impressed and wants him to know it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、人ごみにまぎれて迷ったろ、桜
lines.en: You got lost in the crowd back there, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Dry, knowing smirk in the voice. Light on the deflection — not mean, just turning it back on her. Relaxed pace, almost conversational.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の説明、分りにくいぞ
lines.en: Your explanation was confusing as hell, Riku.
lines.style: Direct callout wrapped in teasing. No apology in her voice. Steady delivery, slight edge on 'confusing'. She means it and doesn't care if he hears it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、むやみにスマホ見るな、桜
lines.en: Stop scrolling on your phone so much, Sakura.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, light concern underneath. Speaking-to-a-friend level of directness, not lecturing. Even pace, slight firmness on the directive.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のスマホの待ち受け、可愛いな
lines.en: Your phone wallpaper is actually pretty cute, you know.
lines.style: Soft, almost bashful admission. Hesitant beat before 'cute' — he's not expecting this to land well. Quiet, genuine. Not performative.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、同じゲームに飽きる事ないのか、桜?
lines.en: How are you not sick of playing the same game over and over?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, slightly baffled. Softer delivery — not mocking, actually wondering. Slight upswing on the question.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、宿題、とっとと終わらせろよ
lines.en: Just finish your homework already, Riku.
lines.style: Exasperated but affectionate. Quick, efficient delivery like she's said this before and will say it again. No malice, just peer-to-peer nagging.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のテスト点が満点なんて、有り得ない快挙だな、桜
lines.en: A perfect score on your test? That's pretty much impossible.
lines.style: Surprised delight with a skeptical edge. Slow on 'impossible' like she's testing the word. Warm underneath the sarcasm — genuinely impressed.
